channel.title: Reads with Colin
channel.description: A weekly letter on the books that change how you see — and what you do next.

item.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow - 思考，快与慢
item.description: I read it to understand the brain’s default. The biggest takeaway: build forced pauses into high-stakes decisions. - 三十多年的判断与决策研究，被压成一本可读的书。核心一句话：你的大脑是两套系统——快而直觉的一套，慢而审慎的一套。

item.title: The Great Mental Models - 思考的框架
item.description: I use reverse-thinking and probability thinking every week. Before a meeting I ask: how would I make this fail? - 不是讲“什么是思维模型”的认知书，而是讲“哪些思维模型最值得收藏”的工具手册。

item.title: The Pyramid Principle - 金字塔原理
item.description: I treat it as my weekly report filter. Conclusion up top, supporting logic below. - 教你把混乱的素材装进一个金字塔，让表达变得有效。

item.title: The Golden Thread - 金线
item.description: I borrowed the "golden thread" metaphor for my weekly notes: what is this week’s golden thread? - 中文学界少有的讲清楚如何把事做成的书。

item.title: The Power of Summarizing - 概括力
item.description: I now write three lines after every long read: who is the protagonist, why does it matter, what do I do tomorrow. - 把"表达不清"这件事拆解到三个动作里。

item.title: The Crowd - 乌合之众
item.description: The first lesson: the crowd is not "wrong" — it is a triggered system with patterns you can read. - 一个世纪前的群体心理学预见，从弹幕到股价都还在证明它。

item.title: Scarcity - 稀缺
item.description: My practice: a daily block of empty time — no tasks, no messages, no scrolling. The antidote to scarcity. - 从脑科学和经济学的双重视角证明——稀缺不是缺少，是注意力被占用。

item.title: A Whole New Mind - 全新思维
item.description: It was published in 2006. The future it predicted is now: design, story, and empathy are the most-valued skills. - 从信息时代到概念时代的过渡——审美、故事与共情最被珍视。

item.title: Poor Charlie's Almanack - 穷查理宝典
item.description: I reframed Munger’s "every problem looks like a nail with a hammer" into "first check whether it is a nail". - 不是一本通常意义上的商业书。是一个九旬老人的讲话集。

item.title: Principles - 原则
item.description: I started writing "daily principles" — small lines that I try to live by and adjust over time. - 表面是个人原则集，实质是一套让生活被审视、被迭代的方法。

item.title: Jobs, Zen & Investing - 乔布斯、禅与投资
item.description: I now block two hours a week purely for focused reading — the "focus itself is wealth" muscle. - 从中文学界视角写的乔布斯传，把心性的哲学与高端商业嫁接起来。

item.title: Poor Economics - 贫穷的本质
item.description: It changed my belief: environment beats resource in shaping outcomes — backed by field research. - 重新审视贫穷是不是真的只缺钱。

item.title: Elon Musk - 硅谷钢铁侠
item.description: Different industries are not separate — they are physics + software. Space, cars, brain-computer are the same. - 马斯克火箭、电动车、脑机接口背后那个"问为什么"的人物侧写。

item.title: Insane Mode - 特斯拉传：实现不可能
item.description: Even "impossible" projects become achievable once broken into small, rhythmic steps. - 人、商业、技术三角并行的"特斯拉制造史"。

item.title: The Last Quarter of the Moon - 额尔古纳河右岸
item.description: It is the tone that moves me — a voice of a civilization fading by your side. - 茅奖作品。一个民族与最后一名记录者，在黑龙江梡木里。

item.title: Life and Death Are Wearing Me Out - 生死瘦劳
item.description: I read it as language exercise. Mo Yan’s sentences "rewind and rewind" — irony is a craft, not a mood. - 诺奖得主以轮回机巧穿梭五十年中国乡土。

item.title: Slaughterhouse-Five - 五号屠场
item.description: Late night read. I thought: "a life without being shaken by a book is still a complete life." Then I respected reading. - 德律斯顿表炸之后，才子的生活崩塌。

item.title: Strait Is the Gate - 窄门
item.description: A book that leaves you wordless. Some gates are too narrow for two people. - 纪德获诺奖的小说。一个女子为完美主义拒绝爱情。

item.title: The Distant Savior - 遥远的救世主
item.description: My most-remembered line: no savior will come, only yourself. I re-read the book every year for it. - 丁元英是一个"只能被谈论的人物"。多谈市场、私募、信任。

item.title: Beyond the Dust of the World - 天幕红尘
item.description: When tempted to imitate, I recall "do not walk the road others walked". A guardrail for originality. - 最被低估的豆豆三部曲之一。

item.title: Betrayal - 背叛
item.description: A friend told me: "betrayal is not which side you chose — it is which choices you have left." - 豆豆三部曲的中间一部。事业与"出卖"的论。

item.title: Dying Is Easier Than Living - 死比活着容易
item.description: I wanted to see how an author talks about life across books. She outsmarts her author. - 豆豆"闭上股找个狗"——作者不完全照作者人设谈人生的第一本。

item.title: At the Bend of the River - 在峡江的转弯处
item.description: "身正不怕影子歪。" This line works outside the bureaucracy too. - 陈行甲退到转身人生所有不甘。

item.title: Just Said - 刚刚说过
item.description: Difficulty is not money — it is seniority, relationship, social order. - 老郭五十写过的"人间世"。

item.title: Living Just Fine - 过得刚好
item.description: "护脾子" is family, not dining. Reading the book gives you a new view of hierarchy. - 老郭相声三十多年的人文集。

item.title: Guo's Discourse - 郭论
item.description: Patience with language and posture. Eat the meal with care — not for show. - 老郭真正抱着"捡就拘了·讲德位"的书。

item.title: Flow - 心流
item.description: Reading this book feels like playing. Not "chicken soup" — solid psychology from the 80s. - 三十多年前的书，预见了互联网时代的"注意力问题"。

item.title: Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind - 禅者的初心
item.description: When stuck, I ask: is this the first time I see this problem? If not, see it as the first time. - 佛门弟子讲"开始心"，说"准备子在世能被联在生活中"。

item.title: The Molecule of More - 贪婪的多巴胺
item.description: The moment of "I want X" is not getting X. That understanding saves me from a few dopamine traps. - 拆解欲望、快乐、遗憾的脑科学书。

item.title: Self-Acceptance - 认同自己
item.description: I recognized the "internal judged listener" pattern. Not born — built up by accumulated judgments. - 一本能读得懂的心理书。

item.title: Fundamentals - 万物原理
item.description: I learned: "you can reframe the world by changing the question." Better questions, better science. - 关于"为什么会是这样"的书。从"看上去那个样"出发。

item.title: Steve Jobs - 史蒂夫·乔布斯
item.description: Most readers see "a man with goods". I see a man dwelling in inner phenomenology. - 艾萨克森写乔布斯、爱因斯坦、富兰克林、达·芬奇。

item.title: The Book of Elon - 马斯克之书
item.description: Two takeaways: question the requirement, delete the step. Try "ask whether I am the right person". - 与其说是马斯克传记，不如说是"用马斯克讲方法论"。

item.title: Strictly Business: The Story of Kwek Leng Beng - 纯商业：郭令明的故事
item.description: Entrepreneurship is opportunities, not motion. Singapore teaches stillness. - 新加坡酒店、百货、置业的商业家族史。

item.title: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant - 纳瓦尔宝典
item.description: Wealth is assets that earn while you sleep. Happiness is wanting what you already have. - 财富是睡着时还在赚钱的资产；幸福是想要自己已有的东西。把两者都当技能来练。
